correctness.rationale: For each fixed k-set, stationarity yields a_k=q^k[(1-k/n)a_k+(k/n)a_{k-1}], hence exact finite product and binomial inversion for the full stationary occupancy law. Coupling from the empty set gives a per-time all-full probability <=pi; coupling arbitrary starts gives TV error <=nq^t and polynomial-size blocks to hit all full with probability >=pi/2. Thus E T has same exponential rate as 1/pi; the product Riemann sum gives I(c)=int_0^1 log[1+(e^{cx}-1)/x]dx. The argument proves fixed c>0 but not a hitting prefactor. Independently verified n=2,q=4/5 stationary mass 32/75. These correct statements exactly reproduce stronger earlier theorems.
